svg.desc: Two optic discs of a right eye, nasal side to the right. Left: normal disc with a small central cup (cup-to-disc ratio about 0.3) and a thick pink rim. Right: glaucomatous disc with a large vertically oval cup (about 0.8), a thin rim at the top and bottom with an inferior notch, vessels shifted to the nasal side and bending sharply (bayoneting) at the cup edge.

g.title: Central retinal artery and vein branches
Thin rim, worst at the top and bottom (inferior notch)
Vessels shifted to the nasal side of the cup
Bayoneting: vessels kink sharply at the cup edge
